topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: When I first saw the design, I couldn’t believe how perfectly it mirrored my latest piece. The intricacy, the shading—every detail was captured with such precision. It was flattering, in a strange way, to see someone admire my work so much they wanted it to be a part of them forever. Yet, I wish they had asked. Sharing art is one thing, but having it etched into someone’s skin... that’s a different level of commitment. I wonder who the artist was, and what they thought about replicating my creation. Maybe I should reach out, to understand their story and share my own.
